question: _________ is one of the first criticism of the caste system written by Mahatma Phule and published in the year 1873.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulamgiri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gulamgiri** is one of the first criticisms of the caste system written by **Mahatma Phule **in** Marathi** language and published in the year **1873**.
 
• This work is a significant text in the social reform movement in India, especially in Maharashtra</strong
